metadata.title: Capital and Service Delivery Channels
metadata.description: Proposed delivery model for human services and their supporting workspaces. Product names are model constructs. Runtime and provider details are assumptions, and no consumer app or software-subscription business is inferred.

channels.description: Logical workspaces, not asserted cloud accounts or custom services.
Proposed logical delivery channel using configured hosted tools, controlled files, and approved integrations. Hosting provider and architecture are unverified.
